title: Kissed Smoke Hot Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A sweet and smoky Malaysian dish featuring dark brown sugar and chicken, perfect for a low-carb brunch
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together dark brown sugar, smoked paprika, fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the chicken satay for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Brush the chicken with coconut milk during the last minute of grilling.
Serve the chicken satay hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and toasted peanuts if desired.
Offer a side of cucumber slices or carrot sticks for a refreshing contrast.
